method: Unchanged BlockHopper (aln) and TileEntityHopper (api) run in the RedstoneProbe World/Chunk fixture with the original chests, furnaces, dispensers/droppers, hoppers, redstone block, comparators and scripted EntityItems. Per tick (tile-entity loop in set order, then scheduled updates) the probe records block id/metadata, every slot, the hopper cooldown, live item entities, the Block comparator override of every container and the TileEntityComparator output; only changed cells are stored. TileEntityFurnace.updateEntity is not ticked (no smelting). Minecart inventories and ocelots are not in the fixture.

scenarios.name: push-down-chest
scenarios.note: hopper facing down into a chest: one item per 8 ticks, first slot first, then the comparator-visible fill

scenarios.name: suck-from-chest-above
scenarios.note: hopper below a chest pulls one item per 8 ticks and, facing down onto air, keeps them

scenarios.name: chain-chest-hopper-hopper-chest
scenarios.note: chest, hopper, side hopper, chest: cooldown handoff between hoppers

scenarios.name: horizontal-into-chest
scenarios.note: hopper facing east into a chest and facing north into a dropper

scenarios.name: furnace-below-input
scenarios.note: hopper above a furnace feeds the input slot (any item, side top), fuel is not accepted from above

scenarios.name: furnace-side-fuel
scenarios.note: hopper beside a furnace feeds only the fuel slot (side slots {1}); non-fuel is refused

scenarios.name: furnace-side-fuel-merge
scenarios.note: side feeding merges into an existing fuel stack and stops when it is full

scenarios.name: furnace-above-output
scenarios.note: furnace above a hopper: output slot first, then the fuel slot only for an empty bucket

scenarios.name: furnace-above-fuel-kept
scenarios.note: an empty output leaves coal in the fuel slot untouched, a bucket there is taken

scenarios.name: furnace-bucket-fuel
scenarios.note: empty bucket in the fuel slot is extractable from the bottom

scenarios.name: pickup-items
scenarios.note: item entities in the 1x1x1 box above (y+1 to y+2): inside, overlapping the edge, too low, too high, beside

scenarios.name: pickup-merge-and-full
scenarios.note: entity stacks merge into partial slots up to the stack size, the remainder stays an entity; a full hopper takes nothing

scenarios.name: pickup-late-spawn
scenarios.note: an item entity that appears later is taken after the cooldown; the empty chest above blocks pickup

scenarios.name: power-disable
scenarios.note: a redstone block beside the hopper disables it (metadata +8), removing it enables it again; powered placement

scenarios.name: double-chest-target
scenarios.note: hopper pushes into a double chest (west half first), fills slot 0 of the left chest

scenarios.name: double-chest-source
scenarios.note: hopper under the east half of a double chest pulls from slot 0 of the west half first

scenarios.name: chest-blocked-above
scenarios.note: a normal cube on a chest above the hopper closes it for pulling; removing it reopens the chest

scenarios.name: chest-blocked-by-stone
scenarios.note: stone above the chest under a hopper's output side: the hopper cannot push

scenarios.name: double-chest-partner-blocked
scenarios.note: stone above only the partner half closes the whole double chest

scenarios.name: dispenser-dropper-sources
scenarios.note: hoppers pull from a dispenser above and push into a dropper below (nine slots)

scenarios.name: stack-rules
scenarios.note: unstackable, 16-stack and damage-split stacks into a half-filled chest; damaged swords never merge

scenarios.name: target-full
scenarios.note: a full destination refuses everything; the hopper keeps its items and its cooldown

scenarios.name: comparator-chest
scenarios.note: comparator (metadata 3 reads from x-1) beside a chest follows hopper transfers live (BlockChest comparator override)

scenarios.name: comparator-hopper
scenarios.note: comparator reading a hopper's own contents (five slots)

scenarios.name: comparator-furnace
scenarios.note: comparator beside a furnace fed through the side by a hopper
